_readme: Site-wide facts and per-page SEO metadata. tools/build.py writes these into every page's <head> (title, description, canonical, Open Graph/Twitter tags, JSON-LD) and into sitemap.xml and llms.txt. Keep titles <= 60 characters and descriptions 120-160 characters; the build warns otherwise. Only state facts that are visible on the site.
